clips.title: The story
paras: Alaric's Remains are the recovered bones of an individual once interred in a shallow grave along Silverpine Forest. His lingering spirit bids travelers to carry what is left of him past the Rot Hide gnolls into the towers of Fenris Keep.

Unearthed from an unremarkable shallow grave in Silverpine Forest, the remains belong to Alaric, a former resident of Fenris Isle. Rather than linger in an exposed pit, his spirit yearns for the place he cherished in life. He asks whoever unearths his bones to leave his ill-fitting boots behind and bring his skeletal remains directly into the keep, seeking quiet sanctuary far away from the scavengers prowling the mainland.
